reason: The free tier already gives me unlimited workout logging and the social feed, so on my student budget I have no real need to pay for an AI coach or meal scans.
objection: I doubt a simple height and weight formula can accurately calculate calorie burn for dynamic sports like padel and swimming, plus all my friends are already on Strava.
would_change_my_mind: If my entire crew switched from Strava and the Pro tier offered verified GPS and heart rate analytics that actually improved my training.
